Waiting for manufacturer input.\" }\n  ]);\n  const terminalEndRef = useRef(null);\n\n  const addLog = (agent, message) => {\n    const time = new Date().toLocaleTimeString();\n    setLogs(prev => [...prev, { id: Date.now(), time, agent, message }]);\n  };\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (terminalEndRef.current) {\n      terminalEndRef.current.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });\n    }\n  }, [logs]);\n\n  // Simulate drop prototype image action\n  const handleUploadImage = (fileName = \"grogu_mockup_box.png\") => {\n    setFlowState('uploading');\n    setChatMessages(prev => [\n      ...prev,\n      { id: Date.now(), sender: 'user', text: `Uploaded mockup file: ${fileName}`, time: new Date().toLocaleTimeString().slice(0, 5) }\n    ]);\n    addLog(\"Orchestrator\", `Ingested product mockup image: ${fileName}`);\n    addLog(\"mcp-vision-analyzer\", \"Running Computer Vision parse_design_elements(image_blob)...\");\n\n    setTimeout(() => {\n      setFlowState('analyzing');\n      addLog(\"Brand Style Compliance Agent\", \"Fetching style registry rules via mcp-ip-registry...\");\n      addLog(\"IP Counsel Agent\", \"Scanning active contracts via mcp-legal-contracts...\");\n      \n      setTimeout(() => {\n        setFlowState('warning');\n        setChatMessages(prev => [\n          ...prev,\n          { \n            id: Date.now(), \n            sender: 'agent', \n            text: \"\u26a0\ufe0f Audit results complete. Found 2 issues:\\n1. Style Warning: Font 'SpaceGrotesk' is unverified for key branding text 'THE CHILD'.\\n2. Legal Collision: Exclusivity conflict in North America (Hasbro holds sole rights for stylized vinyl figures).\",\n            time: new Date().toLocaleTimeString().slice(0, 5)\n          }\n        ]);\n        addLog(\"Brand Style Compliance Agent\", \"WARNING: Font Family 'SpaceGrotesk' does not match certified Star Wars brand guidelines.\");\n        addLog(\"IP Counsel Agent\", \"CRITICAL ERROR: Territorial exclusive clash detected in North America with competitor 'Hasbro' for 'stylized vinyl figures'.\");\n        addLog(\"UI Painter Agent\", \"Painting warning frames on canvas. Emitted flash_threat_vector schema.\");\n      }, 1500);\n    }, 1500);\n  };\n\n  // Chat send message\n  const handleSendMessage = (e) => {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    if (!inputText.trim()) return;\n\n    const userText = inputText;\n    setChatMessages(prev => [\n      ...prev,\n      { id: Date.now(), sender: 'user', text: userText, time: new Date().toLocaleTimeString().slice(0, 5) }\n    ]);\n    setInputText('');\n\n    addLog(\"Orchestrator\", `User prompt received: \"${userText}\"`);\n\n    // Simple keyword processing to trigger actions conversational-style\n    if (userText.toLowerCase().includes('grogu') || userText.toLowerCase().includes('prototype') || userText.toLowerCase().includes('image')) {\n      handleUploadImage();\n    } else if (userText.toLowerCase().includes('europe') || userText.toLowerCase().includes('market')) {\n      setTargetMarket('Europe');\n      addLog(\"Orchestrator\", \"User adjusted market parameter via chat command.\");\n    } else if (userText.toLowerCase().includes('volume') || userText.toLowerCase().includes('capacity')) {\n      setProductionVolume(40000);\n      addLog(\"Orchestrator\", \"User adjusted volume parameter via chat command.\");\n    } else {\n      setTimeout(() => {\n        setChatMessages(prev => [\n          ...prev,\n          { id: Date.now(), sender: 'agent', text: \"Understood. The dynamic canvas workspace is listening. You can upload an image or adjust parameters like destination market and volumes directly to recalculate legal/style compliance.\", time: new Date().toLocaleTimeString().slice(0, 5) }\n        ]);\n      }, 1000);\n    }\n  };\n\n  // Monitor market change to resolve exclusivity collision\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (flowState === 'warning' && targetMarket === 'Europe') {\n      addLog(\"IP Counsel Agent\", \"Re-checking territorial rights for region: Europe...\");\n      addLog(\"mcp-legal-contracts\", \"scan_global_exclusivity_clauses: No exclusivity collision for 'Grogu stylized figurine' in Europe (EU territory).\");\n      addLog(\"mcp-customs-registry\", \"verify_trademark_record: Trademark registrations valid for Europe.\");\n      \n      setFlowState('resolved');\n      setChatMessages(prev => [\n        ...prev,\n        { \n          id: Date.now(), \n          sender: 'agent', \n          text: \"\u2705 Exclusivity collision resolved! Europe is a non-exclusive territory for the manufacturing partner under the Master Licensing Contract.\",\n          time: new Date().toLocaleTimeString().slice(0, 5)\n        }\n      ]);\n      addLog(\"UI Painter Agent\", \"Updating Canvas UI layout contract. Erasing IP collision indicators.\");\n    } else if (flowState === 'resolved' && targetMarket === 'North America') {\n      setFlowState('warning');\n      addLog(\"IP Counsel Agent\", \"WARNING: Switched back to exclusive market. North America blocks distribution release.\");\n    }\n  }, [targetMarket, flowState]);\n\n  // Handle production volume changes and guardrails\n  const handleVolumeChange = (val) => {\n    const parsedVal = parseInt(val);\n    setProductionVolume(parsedVal);\n    \n    if (parsedVal > 25000) {\n      // Guardrail triggers! Snaps back\n      setShowSliderGuardrail(true);\n      setProductionVolume(25000);\n      addLog(\"Orchestrator\", `Volume limit alert: User set production to ${parsedVal}. Cap is 25,000 SKUs without supervisor sign-off.`);\n      addLog(\"mcp-procurement-ledger\", \"check_sku_volume_caps: Contract ID MC-9908 has strict cap of 25,000.\");\n      addLog(\"Orchestrator\", \"Initiating sub-contractor split addendum...\");\n      \n      setTimeout(() => {\n        setShowSliderGuardrail(false);\n        setShowAddendumSuccess(true);\n        addLog(\"Orchestrator\", \"Successfully split off production addendum SC-7798-EU (15,000 units) to secondary partner.\");\n      }, 3500);\n    }\n  };\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"app-container\">\n      \n      {/* 1. Conversational Sidebar */}\n      <aside className=\"sidebar\">\n        <div className=\"sidebar-header\">\n          <div className=\"logo-container\">\n            <span className=\"logo-icon\">\ud83d\udee1\ufe0f</span>\n            <div className=\"logo-text\">\n              <h1>AGY Procurement</h1>\n              <p>License Verification & Audit</p>\n            </div>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n\n        {/* Chat Message Window */}\n        <div className=\"chat-history\">\n          {chatMessages.map(msg => (\n            <div key={msg.id} className={`chat-bubble ${msg.sender}`}>\n              <div>{msg.text}</div>\n              <div className=\"bubble-meta\">{msg.time}</div>\n            </div>\n          ))}\n          {flowState === 'uploading' && (\n            <div className=\"chat-bubble agent\">\n              <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '0.5rem' }}>\n                <RefreshCw size={14} className=\"spin\" style={{ animation: 'spin 2s linear infinite' }} />\n                <span>Orchestrator uploading image and initializing parallel checks...</span>\n              </div>\n            </div>\n          )}\n        </div>\n\n        {/* Input Bar */}\n        <div className=\"drop-message-zone\">\n          <div className=\"preset-images-bar\">\n            <button \n              className=\"preset-btn\" \n              onClick={() => handleUploadImage(\"grogu_vinyl_fig_mockup.jpg\")}\n              disabled={flowState !== 'idle'}\n            >\n              \ud83d\udcf7 Preset Mockup (Grogu)\n            </button>\n            <button \n              className=\"preset-btn\" \n              onClick={() => {\n                setFlowState('idle');\n                setTargetMarket('North America');\n                setProductionVolume(15000);\n                setShowSliderGuardrail(false);\n                setShowAddendumSuccess(false);\n                setChatMessages([{\n                  id: 1,\n                  sender: 'agent',\n                  text: \"Reset complete. Workspace ready for new verification audits.\",\n                  time: new Date().toLocaleTimeString().slice(0, 5)\n                }]);\n                addLog(\"Orchestrator\", \"State workspace reset.\");\n              }}\n            >\n              \ud83d\udd04 Reset Canvas\n            </button>\n          </div>\n\n          {/* Hidden file input */}\n          <input \n            type=\"file\" \n            ref={fileInputRef} \n            className=\"file-input-hidden\" \n            accept=\"image/*\"\n            onChange={(e) => {\n              if (e.target.files && e.target.files[0]) {\n                handleUploadImage(e.target.files[0].name);\n              }\n            }} \n          />\n\n          <form onSubmit={handleSendMessage} className=\"input-container\">\n            <button \n              type=\"button\" \n              className=\"icon-btn\" \n              title=\"Upload / Drop Prototype Image\"\n              onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}\n            >\n              <Upload size={18} />\n            </button>\n            <textarea\n              className=\"chat-textarea\"\n              placeholder=\"Drop image here or type message...\"\n              value={inputText}\n              onChange={(e) => setInputText(e.target.value)}\n              onKeyDown={(e) => {\n                if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) {\n                  e.preventDefault();\n                  handleSendMessage(e);\n                }\n              }}\n              rows={1}\n            />\n            <div className=\"action-buttons\">\n              <button type=\"submit\" className=\"icon-btn primary\">\n                <Send size={16} />\n              </button>\n            </div>\n          </form>\n        </div>\n      </aside>\n\n      {/* 2. Main Adaptive Workspace */}\n      <main className=\"main-workspace\">\n        <header className=\"workspace-header\">\n          <div>\n            <h2 style={{ fontFamily: 'Outfit', fontWeight: 700, fontSize: '1.25rem' }}>\n              Conversational Adaptive Canvas Workspace\n            </h2>\n            <p style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>\n              Rendered via Google A2UI Declarative Interface Contract\n            </p>\n          </div>\n          <div className=\"tab-nav\">\n            <button \n              className={`tab-btn ${activeTab === 'canvas' ? 'active' : ''}`}\n              onClick={() => setActiveTab('canvas')}\n            >\n              <Sliders size={14} style={{ marginRight: '4px', display: 'inline' }} /> Workspace Canvas\n            </button>\n            <button \n              className={`tab-btn ${activeTab === 'contrast' ? 'active' : ''}`}\n              onClick={() => setActiveTab('contrast')}\n            >\n              <BarChart2 size={14} style={{ marginRight: '4px', display: 'inline' }} /> Value Contrast Matrix\n            </button>\n          </div>\n        </header>\n\n        <div className=\"workspace-panels\">\n          \n          {activeTab === 'canvas' ? (\n            <>\n              {/* Milestone Timeline */}\n              <div className=\"timeline-card\">\n                <div className=\"timeline-header\">\n                  <div className=\"timeline-title\">\n                    <Shield size={16} className=\"text-accent\" />\n                    <span>Audit Pipeline Status Milestone</span>\n                  </div>\n                  <span className=\"timeline-status\">\n                    State: <strong>{flowState.toUpperCase()}</strong>\n                  </span>\n                </div>\n                \n                <div className=\"timeline-steps\">\n                  <div className={`timeline-step ${flowState !== 'idle' ? 'completed' : ''}`}>\n                    <div className=\"step-node\">1</div>\n                    <span className=\"step-label\">Mockup Upload</span>\n                    <span className=\"step-desc\">Ingest and parse files</span>\n                  </div>\n                  \n                  <div className={`timeline-step ${\n                    ['analyzing', 'warning', 'resolved', 'completed'].includes(flowState) ? (\n                      flowState === 'warning' ? 'failed' : 'completed'\n                    ) : flowState === 'uploading' ? 'active' : ''\n                  }`}>\n                    <div className=\"step-node\">2</div>\n                    <span className=\"step-label\">Style Check</span>\n                    <span className=\"step-desc\">Typography and design metrics</span>\n                  </div>\n\n                  <div className={`timeline-step ${\n                    ['warning', 'resolved', 'completed'].includes(flowState) ? (\n                      flowState === 'warning' ? 'failed' : 'completed'\n                    ) : flowState === 'analyzing' ? 'active' : ''\n                  }`}>\n                    <div className=\"step-node\">3</div>\n                    <span className=\"step-label\">Market Clearance</span>\n                    <span className=\"step-desc\">Exclusivity rights</span>\n                  </div>\n\n                  <div className={`timeline-step ${\n                    flowState === 'resolved' || flowState === 'completed' ? 'completed' : ''\n                  }`}>\n                    <div className=\"step-node\">4</div>\n                    <span className=\"step-label\">Procurement Release</span>\n                    <span className=\"step-desc\">Approved release to ledger</span>\n                  </div>\n                </div>\n              </div>\n\n              {/* Dynamic Canvas Area */}\n              <div className=\"canvas-grid\">\n                \n                {/* Visual Packaging Sandbox (Style Agent / UI Painter) */}\n                <div className=\"canvas-panel\">\n                  <h3 className=\"panel-title\">\n                    <span>\ud83d\uddbc\ufe0f Prototype Box Viewport</span>\n                  </h3>\n                  \n                  <div className=\"mockup-display\">\n                    {flowState === 'idle' ? (\n                      <div className=\"mockup-placeholder\">\n                        <Upload size={32} />\n                        <div>\n                          <p style={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>Drop Packaging Design Mockup Image</p>\n                          <p style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', marginTop: '0.25rem' }}>\n                            (Select the Grogu preset mockup on the sidebar to simulate)\n                          </p>\n                        </div>\n                      </div>\n                    ) : (\n                      <div style={{ position: 'relative', width: '100%', height: '100%', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', padding: '1rem' }}>\n                        \n                        {/* CSS Model Box representing the packaging box mockup */}\n                        <div style={{\n                          width: '200px',\n                          height: '280px',\n                          background: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #1e293b 0%, #0f172a 100%)',\n                          border: '2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2)',\n                          borderRadius: '8px',\n                          position: 'relative',\n                          display: 'flex',\n                          flexDirection: 'column',\n                          justifyContent: 'space-between',\n                          padding: '1rem',\n                          boxShadow: '0 10px 25px rgba(0,0,0,0.5)'\n                        }}>\n                          {/* Box Header */}\n                          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' }}>\n                            <span style={{ fontSize: '0.6rem', color: '#10b981', fontWeight: 800, border: '1px solid #10b981', padding: '1px 3px', borderRadius: '3px' }}>STAR WARS</span>\n                            <span style={{ fontSize: '0.5rem', color: '#94a3b8' }}>VINYL FIGURINE</span>\n                          </div>\n\n                          {/* Figure visual representation */}\n                          <div style={{ flex: 1, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', margin: '0.5rem 0', background: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.4)', borderRadius: '4px' }}>\n                            <div style={{ fontSize: '3rem' }}>\ud83d\udc7d</div>\n                          </div>\n\n                          {/* Box Title */}\n                          <div style={{ textAlign: 'center' }}>\n                            <div style={{ fontSize: '0.5rem', color: '#94a3b8' }}>POP SERIES #339</div>\n                            <div style={{ \n                              fontSize: '0.9rem', \n                              fontWeight: 700, \n                              color: '#fff', \n                              fontFamily: flowState === 'warning' ? 'SpaceGrotesk' : 'Outfit', \n                              letterSpacing: '0.05em' \n                            }}>\n                              THE CHILD\n                            </div>\n                          </div>\n\n                          {/* Warning overlays rendered from UI Painter A2UI JSON payload */}\n                          {flowState === 'warning' && (\n                            <>\n                              {/* Overlay for Font Typo */}\n                              <div \n                                className=\"warning-overlay-box\" \n                                style={{ top: '220px', left: '15px', width: '170px', height: '30px' }}\n                              >\n                                <span className=\"warning-tooltip\">Typography Error (SpaceGrotesk)</span>\n                              </div>\n\n                              {/* Overlay for Exclusivity conflict */}\n                              <div \n                                className=\"warning-overlay-box danger\" \n                                style={{ top: '10px', left: '10px', width: '180px', height: '260px' }}\n                              >\n                                <span className=\"warning-tooltip\" style={{ top: '50%' }}>NA Exclusivity Collision (Hasbro)</span>\n                              </div>\n                            </>\n                          )}\n                        </div>\n                      </div>\n                    )}\n                  </div>\n                </div>\n\n                {/* Adaptive Parameter Remediation Workspace (IP Counsel / UI Painter) */}\n                <div className=\"canvas-panel\">\n                  <h3 className=\"panel-title\">\n                    <span>\u26a1 Adaptive Remediation Canvas</span>\n                  </h3>\n\n                  {flowState === 'idle' ? (\n                    <div style={{ flex: 1, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', color: 'var(--text-muted)', fontSize: '0.85rem' }}>\n                      Waiting for active prototype audit to build dynamic layout controls.\n                    </div>\n                  ) : (\n                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', height: '100%', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}>\n                      <div>\n                        \n                        {/* Legal warning card */}\n                        {flowState === 'warning' && (\n                          <div className=\"risk-card\">\n                            <div className=\"risk-title text-danger\" style={{ color: 'var(--color-danger)' }}>\n                              <AlertCircle size={14} /> Exclusivity Collision (North America)\n                            </div>\n                            <p className=\"risk-desc\">\n                              Hasbro possesses exclusive rights to manufacture and distribute stylized vinyl figurines of Star Wars IPs in the North American territory. Clear this before release.\n                            </p>\n                          </div>\n                        )}\n\n                        {/* Font warning card */}\n                        {flowState === 'warning' && (\n                          <div className=\"risk-card warning\">\n                            <div className=\"risk-title\" style={{ color: 'var(--color-warning)' }}>\n                              <AlertTriangle size={14} /> Unverified Branding Typography\n                            </div>\n                            <p className=\"risk-desc\">\n                              Font variant \"SpaceGrotesk\" detected on box front text. Style guidelines mandate standard \"Outfit\" or certified family vectors for the \"THE CHILD\" token.\n                            </p>\n                          </div>\n                        )}\n\n                        {flowState === 'resolved' && (\n                          <div className=\"risk-card\" style={{ background: 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.05)', borderColor: 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.2)' }}>\n                            <div className=\"risk-title\" style={{ color: 'var(--color-success)' }}>\n                              <CheckCircle size={14} /> Compliance Audits Passed\n                            </div>\n                            <p className=\"risk-desc\">\n                              Licensing contract valid for Europe. Auto-fallback to official branding vector style updated. Ready to schedule official production release.\n                            </p>\n                          </div>\n                        )}\n\n                        {/* Dynamic Field Form Painted by Dynamic Canvas UI Painter Agent */}\n                        <div className=\"form-group\">\n                          <label className=\"form-label\">\n                            <span>Target Distribution Territory</span>\n                            <span style={{ color: 'var(--accent-blue)' }}>mcp-legal-contracts</span>\n                          </label>\n                          <select \n                            className=\"form-select\"\n                            value={targetMarket}\n                            onChange={(e) => setTargetMarket(e.target.value)}\n                          >\n                            <option value=\"North America\">North America (Hasbro Exclusive Territory)</option>\n                            <option value=\"Europe\">Europe (Non-Exclusive Territory)</option>\n                          </select>\n                        </div>\n\n                        {/* Adaptive Volume Slider */}\n                        <div className=\"form-group\">\n                          <label className=\"form-label\">\n                            <span>Target Sourcing Capacity (SKUs)</span>\n                            <span style={{ color: 'var(--accent-blue)' }}>mcp-procurement-ledger</span>\n                          </label>\n                          <div className=\"volume-slider-container\">\n                            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', fontSize: '0.85rem' }}>\n                              <span>{productionVolume.toLocaleString()} units</span>\n                              <span style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>Max Cap: 25,000</span>\n                            </div>\n                            \n                            <input \n                              type=\"range\" \n                              min=\"5000\" \n                              max=\"50000\" \n                              step=\"5000\" \n                              value={productionVolume}\n                              className=\"slider-control\"\n                              onChange={(e) => handleVolumeChange(e.target.value)}\n                            />\n\n                            {/* Guardrail active warning */}\n                            {showSliderGuardrail && (\n                              <div className=\"slider-cap-alert\">\n                                <AlertCircle size={14} style={{ flexShrink: 0 }} />\n                                <span>\n                                  <strong>Guardrail Block:</strong> Volume capped at 25,000 for this license. Automatically generating contract splitting addendum...\n                                </span>\n                              </div>\n                            )}\n\n                            {showAddendumSuccess && (\n                              <div className=\"slider-cap-alert\" style={{ color: 'var(--color-success)', background: 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.08)', borderColor: 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.2)' }}>\n                                <CheckCircle size={14} style={{ flexShrink: 0 }} />\n                                <span>\n                                  <strong>Split Approved:</strong> Sourced 25,000 units to primary partner; 15,000 units split into Addendum SC-7798-EU.\n                                </span>\n                              </div>\n                            )}\n                          </div>\n                        </div>\n\n                      </div>\n\n                      {/* Action trigger button */}\n                      <button \n                        className=\"preset-btn\"\n                        style={{\n                          width: '100%',\n                          padding: '0.85rem',\n                          background: flowState === 'resolved' ? 'var(--color-success)' : 'var(--bg-tertiary)',\n                          borderColor: flowState === 'resolved' ? 'var(--color-success)' : 'var(--glass-border)',\n                          fontWeight: 700,\n                          fontSize: '0.85rem',\n                          display: 'flex',\n                          alignItems: 'center',\n                          justifyContent: 'center',\n                          gap: '0.5rem',\n                          color: flowState === 'resolved' ? 'white' : 'var(--text-muted)',\n                          cursor: flowState === 'resolved' ? 'pointer' : 'not-allowed'\n                        }}\n                        disabled={flowState !== 'resolved'}\n                        onClick={() => {\n                          setFlowState('completed');\n                          addLog(\"Orchestrator\", \"Official production release request scheduled on ledger.\");\n                          setChatMessages(prev => [\n                            ...prev,\n                            { id: Date.now(), sender: 'agent', text: \"\ud83d\ude80 License release request successfully finalized, registered, and scheduled on the procurement ledger ledger!\", time: new Date().toLocaleTimeString().slice(0, 5) }\n                          ]);\n                        }}\n                      >\n                        <Play size={16} /> Release Release Request\n                      </button>\n                    </div>\n                  )}\n\n                </div>\n\n              </div>\n\n              {/* Console logs */}\n              <div style={{ marginTop: '1rem' }}>\n                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '0.5rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)', fontSize: '0.75rem', marginBottom: '0.5rem' }}>\n                  <Terminal size={14} />\n                  <span>Simulated ADK 2.0 Multi-Agent Execution Telemetry Logs</span>\n                </div>\n                <div className=\"terminal-card\">\n                  {logs.map(log => (\n                    <div key={log.id} className=\"log-line\">\n                      <span className=\"log-timestamp\">[{log.time}]</span>\n                      <span className=\"log-agent\">{log.agent}:</span>\n                      <span style={{ color: '#fff' }}>{log.message}</span>\n                    </div>\n                  ))}\n                  <div ref={terminalEndRef} />\n                </div>\n              </div>\n            </>\n          ) : (\n            /* Contrast Matrix */\n            <div className=\"matrix-card\">\n              <h3 className=\"panel-title\" style={{ borderBottom: 'none', paddingBottom: 0 }}>\n                \ud83d\udcc8 Demo Contrast Matrix: Stakeholder Value Realization\n              </h3>\n              <p style={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)', marginBottom: '1rem' }}>\n                How the dynamic agentic workspace upgrades standard procurement cycles.\n              </p>\n              \n              <table className=\"matrix-table\">\n                <thead>\n                  <tr>\n                    <th>Operational Phase</th>\n                    <th>The Manual Way (Status Quo)</th>\n                    <th>The Agentic Canvas Way (ADK 2.0 + MCP)</th>\n                  </tr>\n                </thead>\n                <tbody>\n                  <tr>\n                    <td><strong>Asset Ingestion</strong></td>\n                    <td className=\"manual\">Sifting through manufacturer emails; downloading loose image attachments.</td>\n                    <td className=\"agentic\">Instant. Drag-and-drop file parsing via Computer Vision matches character IP automatically.</td>\n                  </tr>\n                  <tr>\n                    <td><strong>Style Verification</strong></td>\n                    <td className=\"manual\">Visually comparing prototype print mockups against a static, 200-page Brand Guidelines PDF.</td>\n                    <td className=\"agentic\">Automated. ### Model Response:
I have updated the frontend code in [App.jsx](file:///Users/linchr/Desktop/work/vibeflix/frontend/src/App.jsx) to implement the sequential input rendering and visual agent execution flow graph:

### 🔄 Dynamic & Sequential Input Rendering
1.  **Kickoff**: When in the initial `idle` state, the adaptive canvas workspace prompts you to trigger a kickoff by either uploading the mockup design or typing `kickoff grogu` in the chat window. 
2.  **Territory Focus**: Once the audit starts and is flagged by the **IP Counsel Agent** (in `warning` state), the UI dynamically reveals **only** the territory selection input and wraps it in a red warning border, requiring selection of a non-exclusive territory (Europe) to clear the block.
3.  **Volume Allocation**: Once the territory block is resolved and clearances are approved (in `resolved` state), the UI transitions to hide the warning checks and dynamically paints the **Sourcing Capacity Slider** to declare volume limits.
4.  **Final Sourcing Transaction**: After volume allocation and guardrail addendum generation, the UI replaces the slider with a signed ledger transaction receipt containing transaction hashes and split addendum numbers.

### 📊 Multi-Agent Execution DAG Graph
Below the canvas panels, I have created a visual **ADK 2.0 Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG)** showing:
*   **Orchestrator Node**: Serves as the graph's workflow coordinator.
*   **Brand Style Node & IP Counsel Node**: Run in parallel (reflecting ADK 2.0 parallel execution branches) to evaluate compliance.
*   **UI Painter Node**: Compiles the A2UI declarative rendering layouts.
*   **Release Ledger Node**: Writes signed releases on completion.

The graph's nodes, borders, and paths glow dynamically (green, amber, or pulsing red) to represent the current agent execution state in real time!

### 🤖 Autonomous Agent-to-Agent Negotiation
When you trigger **Scenario 2**, the adaptive canvas enters a new **`negotiating`** state. Instead of showing warnings that wait for manual parameter overrides, the workspace renders a real-time **Multi-Agent Negotiation Stream**:

1.  **Exclusivity Block**: The `IP Counsel Agent` scans the contracts, flags the North American exclusivity block, and queries other global markets using `check_territorial_rights()`.
2.  **Territory Negotiation**: The IP Counsel Agent identifies Europe as an open territory and proposes a reroute.
3.  **Facility & Style Check**: The `Brand Style Agent` validates the proposed European print facility capabilities and style guidelines, confirming a pass *provided* the font is swapped to the certified `Outfit-Bold` variant.
4.  **Storyline Embargo Check**: The `Franchise Storyline Agent` reviews the European launch scripts and embargo dates, checking that no Season 3 spoilers are leaked in the region.
5.  **Resolution Sourcing**: The agents autonomously finalize the compromise. The `Orchestrator` invokes the rendering layout tool to update the target market dropdown on the canvas to **Europe** and correct the font structure to **Outfit** automatically.

The dashboard completes the audit and transitions to `resolved` without any human intervention required to solve the legal/style block!

1: # How to Run & Verify the Merchandising License Audit Workspace
2: 
3: This guide walks you through launching and testing the conversational adaptive canvas workspace, backend Python agents, and grouped MCP servers.
4: 
5: ---
6: 
7: ## 📋 System Prerequisites
8: 
9: Ensure you have the following installed on your machine:
10: *   **Node.js & npm** (Node 18+ recommended)
11: *   **Python 3.10+** & `pip` (or **`uv`** for 10-100x faster package installation)
12: *   **Virtualenv** (`python3 -m venv` or `uv venv`)
13: 
14: ---
15: 
16: ## 🚀 Execution Order
17: 
18: For full integration, launch services in this order:
19: 1.  **Independent MCP Servers** (Start the registries and analytics backends)
20: 2.  **ADK 2.0 Agent Backend** (Launch the FastAPI coordinator endpoint)
21: 3.  **A2UI Web Frontend** (Launch the interactive UI console)
22: 
23: ---
24: 
25: ## 🛠️ Step-by-Step Running Guide
26: 
27: ### Step 1: Start Grouped MCP Servers
28: 
29: Open three separate terminal tabs (or processes) to run each of the independent servers:
30:

### Model Response:
I have updated the positioning system in [App.jsx](file:///Users/linchr/Desktop/work/vibeflix/frontend/src/App.jsx) to ensure the lines align perfectly with the source and destination agent cards.

### What Was Happening:
Because screen ratios differ from the SVG’s aspect ratio (3:1), the browser was applying its default scaling constraint (`preserveAspectRatio="meet"`). This was causing the entire overlay layer to compress/letterbox, making the lines float in empty space disconnected from the cards.

### The Fix:
1. **Added `preserveAspectRatio="none"`**: This forces the SVG's virtual width and height coordinates (`viewBox="0 0 300 100"`) to stretch exactly to the physical container width and height.
2. **Added `overflow: "visible"`**: Allows curved quadratic arcs to sweep slightly above the bounding container if necessary without being clipped.
3. **Aligned `top: 0`**: Ensures the base reference line (`y = 35` inside the coordinate space) lines up precisely with the top header region of the physical cards.

Now, on any browser width, the lines will anchor exactly inside the active source card and point directly to the destination card.

## 🤖 Step 552: Planner Action & Reasoning
**Timestamp**: `2026-06-25T15:41:37Z` | **Source**: `MODEL`

### Model Response:
I have successfully decoupled the label text from the SVG coordinate grid in [App.jsx](file:///Users/linchr/Desktop/work/vibeflix/frontend/src/App.jsx) to resolve the font stretching distortion!

### What Was Happening:
When we used `preserveAspectRatio="none"` to stretch the SVG connecting arrows across card columns, it was scaling the SVG `<text>` elements along with the paths, which stretched the letters into distorted, wide shapes.

### The Fix:
1. **Removed `<text>` elements from the SVG overlay**: Keeping only the animated `<path>` elements inside the stretched SVG canvas.
2. **Introduced HTML Floating Badges**: Rendered the labels as absolute `<div style={{ position: 'absolute' }}>` elements placed just above the SVG curves.
3. **Styling and Centering**:
   * Styled each label with a clean, semi-transparent card background (`var(--bg-card)`), a subtle border (`var(--glass-border)`), a small shadow, and `transform: 'translateX(-50%)'`.
   * Centered them horizontally at `33.3%`, `50%`, or `66.6%` to sit exactly at the peak of each curve.

This ensures the arrows stretch exactly from agent to agent, while the text labels remain perfectly crisp, readable, and undistorted!

* When the audit passes verification, the button immediately transforms into a success-colored, spinning indicator:

## 🤖 Step 624: Planner Action & Reasoning
**Timestamp**: `2026-06-25T16:13:45Z` | **Source**: `MODEL`

### Model Response:
In the Vibeflix licensing audit framework, the **Ledger Sourcing Agent** (represented by the `mcp-procurement-ledger` tool/registry layer in [App.jsx](file:///Users/linchr/Desktop/work/vibeflix/frontend/src/App.jsx)) acts as the final transaction gatekeeper. 

Its core responsibilities include:

1. **Volume Cap Enforcement**
   * Before any sourcing release is approved, it audits the requested manufacturing volumes against strict capacity caps (like the primary factory limit of **25,000 units** in Scenario 3).
   * If volume limits are exceeded, it halts the flow and triggers a guardrail block requesting override options.

2. **Automated Remediation (Splits & Capping)**
   * Upon receiving brand manager overrides, it records the remediation path in the transaction history:
     * **Option A (Split Sourcing)**: Cryptographically splits the order, writing the primary 25,000 units to the main vendor and shifting the excess 15,000 units to a secondary manufacturer under a legal contract addendum (`SC-7798-EU`).
     * **Option B (Enforce Cap)**: Snaps the procurement volume down to the exact 25,000-unit limit and cancels the excess.

3. **Transaction Signature (Ledger Commit)**
   * Once all compliance metrics (Style, Legal IP, Storyline) pass, it writes a secure, transaction-signed receipt of the final sourcing details to the cryptographic manufacturing registry to prevent downstream tampering.

4. **Dynamic UI Mapping**
   * Feed statuses directly into the second row of the **Proposed Multi-Agent Execution Graph** to update the checklist progress (*1. Sourcing Cap check* and *2. Sign transaction ledger*) in real-time.

1. **Google Fonts Link Tag Updated**: In [index.html](file:///Users/linchr/Desktop/work/vibeflix/frontend/index.html#L11), I added the query parameter for `Open+Sans` to fetch weight sizes `300` to `800` from the Google Fonts CDN:
   ```html
   <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700&family=Open+Sans:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800&family=Outfit:wght@400;500;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
   ```
2. **Set as Default Variable**: In [index.css](file:///Users/linchr/Desktop/work/vibeflix/frontend/src/index.css#L3-L5), I updated the root custom CSS variable definition:
   ```css
   --font-family-primary: 'Open Sans', 'Inter', sans-serif;
   --font-family-opensans: 'Open Sans', sans-serif;
   --font-family-inter: 'Inter', sans-serif;
   ```

Because `--font-family-primary` has been updated to prioritize `'Open Sans'`, the body typography of the entire application will now render using **Open Sans** (with fallback back to *Inter* or standard sans-serif system fonts if offline). You can toggle back and forth inside `index.css` at any time!

### Can you change it to Open Sans or another font?
Yes, absolutely! The display font is driven by the CSS variable `--font-family-display` declared in [index.css](file:///Users/linchr/Desktop/work/vibeflix/frontend/src/index.css#L6).

If you want the header (and all other panel titles) to use **Open Sans** instead of **Outfit**, you can modify the variable inside your `index.css` file:

```css
/* In index.css */
:root {
  /* Change this line: */
  --font-family-display: 'Open Sans', sans-serif; 
}
```

Compiles A2UI canvas payloads to tell the React client which forms to draw dynamically based on parameters.\n\n### 4.2 Agent Definitions\n*   **Brand Style Compliance Agent** ([agents/brand_style/agent.py](file:///Users/linchr/Desktop/work/vibeflix/agents/brand_style/agent.py)): Verifies text typography, palette structures, and logo placements against style guides. Flags font errors (e.g. `SpaceGrotesk` font structures).\n*   **Global Market Clearance & IP Counsel Agent** ([agents/ip_counsel/agent.py](file:///Users/linchr/Desktop/work/vibeflix/agents/ip_counsel/agent.py)): Queries exclusivity lists, region contracts, and customs status. Detects conflict locks (e.g. Hasbro exclusivity).\n*   **Franchise Storyline & Lore Agent** ([agents/storyline/agent.py](file:///Users/linchr/Desktop/work/vibeflix/agents/storyline/agent.py)): Compares box design descriptions and graphic assets against unreleased scripts and active embargo timelines to catch canon discrepancies and leakage spoilers.\n\n---\n\n## \ud83d\udd0c 5. Model Context Protocol (MCP) Servers\n\nTools are decoupled into three independent server programs inside [mcp_servers/](file:///Users/linchr/Desktop/work/vibeflix/mcp_servers):\n\n1.  **`mcp_vision_ui`** (Vision & UI Painter):\n    *   `parse_mockup_graphics`: Extracts typographic text, colors, and layout ratios from design images.\n    *   `compile_canvas_schema`: Generates dynamic A2UI layouts based on remediation requirements.\n2.  **`mcp_legal`** (IP & Licensing Contracts Registry):\n    *   `scan_global_exclusivity_clauses`: Checks if a specific region contains exclusive trademark licenses with third-party manufacturers.\n    *   `validate_trademark_customs`: Checks import/export customs clearance registrations.\n3.  **`mcp_market`** (E-Commerce Scraper & Ledger Capacity):\n    *   `verify_ledger_volume_caps`: Validates if a procurement request exceeds the primary vendor's volume limits.\n    *   `scrape_ecommerce_preorders`: Scrapes endpoints for unauthorized leaks or bootlegs.\n\n---\n\n## \ud83c\udfad 6. Walkthrough of Scenarios\n\n*   **Scenario 1: Clean (Pass)**: Grogu plush design matches all guidelines, uses certified Outfit typography, target market is Europe (non-exclusive), and volume (15k) is within limits. The system automatically finalizes the release to the ledger after 2 seconds.\n*   **Scenario 2: Agent Mesh (Collab)**: Ingests a design using uncertified SpaceGrotesk font, target market is North America (Hasbro exclusivity lock), and the design depicts a Season 4 lightsaber script spoiler. The agents communicate in a multi-turn loop, replace the uncertified font, swap the spoiler image with a canonical hover-pram graphic, and reroute the market to Europe automatically.\n*   **Scenario 3: Overrides (HITL)**: Request for 40,000 units exceeds the primary vendor limit of 25,000. Sourcing halts, requiring a human override:\n    *   **Option A**: Split sourcing, redirecting the excess 15,000 units to Addendum Contract SC-7798-EU.\n    *   **Option B**: Cap procurement volume strictly at 25,000 units and cancel the excess.\n*   **Scenario 4: Spoilers (Fail)**: Ingests an import prototype that leaks unreleased Season 4 storyline spoilers (Grogu wielding a lightsaber). The Storyline Agent flags a critical breach, triggering a hard audit failure and blocking release operations immediately.\n",
